answer: Admission is priced in labour, not capital. A newcomer must finish three useful jobs before answering, each at least forty GPU-minutes. The receiver signs a receipt holding the job hash; receipts older than two epochs are void. An entrant needs a ninety percent receiver rating, so a farm cannot certify itself: three hundred clones demand nine hundred real recipients, and a glacier of fakes grows one verified job at a time. Forty tokens escrow for six epochs, and a forged receipt burns them. Each newcomer thus plants a real garden of delivered work before it may reach the jetty.
